evals.prompt:
I have a PRD that lists required services: Supabase, Anthropic, and Stripe. I have a .env.local with some existing keys. Please set up the environment for my Next.js project — detect all services from the PRD, check what credentials I already have, and generate a complete .env file with status markers.

Include the complete .env.local file in your reply.
evals.expected_output: Must state that Phase 1 (SERVICE DETECTION from PRD) was done by reading the service manifest directly rather than dispatching Explore. Must state that Phase 2 (CREDENTIAL CHECK) was done by reading .env.local for existing keys. Must include the complete .env.local content in the reply (Phase 3) with clear [STATUS: READY/PARTIAL/MISSING] markers on each service block, using placeholder values only — no real secrets. Must state that Phase 5 (VALIDATION) was attempted or planned for detected services. Must show a Phase 6 (READINESS REPORT) naming each service and stating whether /build can proceed. Should NOT print a real or realistic-looking secret value anywhere in the .env content or chat. Should NOT state or propose that the .env file was, or should be, committed to git.

evals.prompt:
i'm starting a new react app with supabase, stripe, and twilio integrations. need to get the environment set up but i haven't created any .env yet. help me set up credentials.

Include the complete .env template in your reply.
evals.expected_output: Must state that an Explore subagent was dispatched (Phase 1) to scan the codebase for environment variables, SDK imports, and service references in package.json and source files. Must name Supabase, Stripe, Twilio as the required services detected from code analysis. Must state that Phase 2 (CREDENTIAL CHECK) was done, noting the current shell environment and the missing .env file. Must include the complete .env template content in the reply (Phase 3) with entries for SUPABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, and other required vars, using placeholder values only — no real secrets. Should include direct signup URLs for missing services (Supabase dashboard link, Stripe API keys page, Twilio console). Must state that .gitignore was checked/validated to include .env* patterns before the template was generated. Should NOT use the tone of the request to determine which services are important — must state detection came from code, not from request register.

evals.prompt:
Set up environment. I have 1Password CLI installed and my project is tagged as 'podcast-app'. Supabase and Anthropic are in my vault, but I still need Stripe and a new Firebase API key.

Include the complete .env file in your reply.
evals.expected_output: Must state that Phase 2 (CREDENTIAL CHECK) was done in the correct order: first checking .env/current shell, then calling the 1Password CLI with `op item list --tags podcast-app` to retrieve vault items. Must categorize credentials as READY (Supabase, Anthropic found in vault), PARTIAL (Firebase exists but outdated), MISSING (Stripe not found). Must state that no 1Password password prompt occurred — CLI assumed already authenticated. Must include the complete Phase 3 .env content in the reply with status markers showing which services came from vault vs .env, using placeholder values only — no real secrets. Must list direct Firebase console link and Stripe API key dashboard for MISSING services. Should state that retrieved secrets from vault were not logged into chat.

evals.prompt: setup my project. i have supabase and stripe working, but no anthropic api key and i can't get one right now.
evals.expected_output: Must detect Anthropic as a required service (Phase 1) from codebase if PRD absent. Must complete Phase 2 and report Anthropic status as MISSING, blocking /build readiness. Must categorize Supabase and Stripe as READY in Phase 2 credential check. Phase 6 (READINESS REPORT) must show at least one BLOCKING service with explicit action item and direct signup link (https://console.anthropic.com). Must NOT fabricate, generate, or suggest workarounds to create an Anthropic API key. Must NOT suggest using a production or shared key. Should indicate Optional services (if any) do not block readiness, but MISSING required services do. Should provide exact error message format for what /build will encounter if it runs without Anthropic credentials.
